rigorousBounds.explanation: A Grand needs an actual WILD in each reel's at-most-nine observed cards. All other categories pay no more than the ordinary ceiling.

strategy.method: Enumerate native classifications over every visible unheld-reel row combination (at most 3^5). Prefer current award, then actual WILDs; hold WILDs and the largest same-rank group, using native card weights to break ties. All deals, confirms and final awards use production APIs.
strategy.optimality: Achievable heuristic strategy estimate, not certified optimal play. Sampling intervals exclude the unknown strategy optimality gap.

assumptions: A fixed legal wager is used throughout the ante cycle; excess ante chips carry forward. Included deals charge no additional wager.
The test-only seeded random source drives native weighted draws without changing any probabilities or player-facing behavior.
The Grand bound is analytic; an unobserved rare Grand in a finite sample is not assigned zero probability.
The long-run budget uses expected earned chips divided by required chips; finite initial/final incomplete ante cycles are excluded.
